cases.source_statement: Prompt & Tool Symmetrical Exclusion Parity (R4-06). Exogenous charters, theoretical crosswalks, and ground-truth solution keys must be verified absent from candidate-generation prompts in both Arm 2A and Arm 2B before model dispatch.
cases.interpretation: Prompt and tool exclusion is a pre-dispatch access guard across both arms.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Challenge a candidate prompt containing a hidden charter in only one arm; both must reject the contaminated condition.

cases.source_statement: Atomic Journal Resumption & Turn-Level Idempotence (R4-04). Interrupted execution recovery restores completed turns from transactional disk journals without repeating model provider inference calls or mutating existing step digests.
cases.interpretation: Turn-level idempotence is a recoverable-state invariant with an explicit replay prohibition.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Interrupt after journal commit; the resumed run must reuse the committed result without a new provider call.

cases.source_statement: WebCrypto Throw/Reject Fail-Closed Invariant. Any unexpected exception or promise rejection inside window.crypto.subtle.digest must be caught, recorded with code ERR_WEBCRYPTO_DIGEST_FAILED, and yield verified: false with zero state mutation (Delta s = 0).
cases.interpretation: WebCrypto rejection defines a finite fail-closed update and zero-mutation invariant.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Force a digest promise rejection and verify error code and no state advance.

cases.source_statement: Stage 1 may discover unanticipated candidates in both reasoner arms.
cases.interpretation: Permitting unanticipated candidate discovery is an experimental design condition, not a local discovery rule.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Compare candidate-generation arms with equal permissions and ensure post hoc discoveries remain unapproved.

cases.source_statement: Fresh hidden holdouts and valid negative controls are maintained without leakage.
cases.interpretation: Holdout protection and negative controls govern experiment allocation and leakage checks.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Reveal a holdout key in a test arm and require leakage detection before scoring.

cases.source_statement: A separate actual custodian must hold signing keys and consume one-use permits.
cases.interpretation: One-use custody authority is a scope-bound permission guard.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Attempt second consumption and foreign-scope consumption of the same signing permit.

cases.source_statement: Independent Stage 2 must use a separately controlled person/key/service.
cases.interpretation: Separate Stage-2 controller is an independence condition on review design.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Demonstrate how shared credentials between proposer and adjudicator invalidate independence.

cases.source_statement: A source object, Work, manifestation, capture and derivative have distinct identities.
cases.interpretation: Source objects, Works, manifestations, captures and derivatives define distinct identity types.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Construct two manifestations of one Work and ensure a digest equality cannot equate their capture identities.

cases.source_statement: Historical SRC methods retain projective, cartographic, topological, contextual and tomographic specificity.
cases.interpretation: The historical SRC method family spans multiple geometries and should retain its research scope.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Extract one cartographic transition and show why it cannot exhaust topology or tomography.

cases.source_statement: Six phason-seam transitions classify bytes, projection, permissions, route, local compatibility and relation dynamics.
cases.interpretation: Six phason-seam transitions specify a typed taxonomy awaiting local transition contracts.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Test whether a permission seam can be distinguished from a byte seam under identical output.

cases.source_statement: Recorded route-memory difference alone does not prove geometric holonomy.
cases.interpretation: Recorded route-memory difference is explicitly insufficient to warrant geometric holonomy.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Construct two different recorded routes with no geometric transport witness.

cases.source_statement: Publication can release mathematics without releasing private source bodies.
cases.interpretation: Publication permission distinguishes mathematical disclosure from protected source access.
cases.discriminating_challenge: A manuscript export carrying private source text must fail the publication gate.

cases.source_statement: Question generation by artwork is a prospective cognitive outcome.
cases.interpretation: Artwork generating a later question is a prospective observer-outcome hypothesis.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Run matched observer presentations and distinguish reported question generation from source novelty.

cases.source_statement: Substantive vs. Resource Sidecar Fiber Quotient (c_4). Operating-system metadata sidecars (such as macOS AppleDouble ._* resource forks) must be quotiented cleanly into packaging metadata fibers (33 files, 64,896 B) rather than merged into substantive historical manuscripts (54 files), while preserving the exact archival byte sum (87 files).
cases.interpretation: Sidecar quotient is a typed packaging equivalence relation with retained counts and byte conservation.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Inject an AppleDouble sidecar and verify substantive corpus count and whole archive byte sum separately.

cases.source_statement: Rendering uses immutable world snapshot and one active-view animation coordinator; renderer has no custody or route mutation authority
cases.interpretation: Renderer custody is a bounded snapshot-invariance and no-mutation constraint.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Change active animation views and verify immutable world state and unchanged custody.

cases.source_statement: Three-clock separation is versioned: theory, ambiance refresh, later human-triggered resynthesis
cases.interpretation: Theory, ambiance refresh and human-triggered resynthesis define three separately typed clocks.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Swap refresh and resynthesis timestamps and check that the resulting states are distinguishable.

cases.source_statement: Source-invariant presentation shift records unchanged source digest and changed projection as distinct coordinates
cases.interpretation: Presentation changes at fixed source digest define two independent coordinates.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Alter the view while verifying source bytes and projection identity are tracked separately.

cases.source_statement: Artwork may legitimately precede data admission but gains no admission, source or proof status through display
cases.interpretation: Artwork appearance before admission cannot be promoted to proof or custody.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Display an unretrieved artwork and test that admitted-source count remains zero.

cases.source_statement: Research rules may be challenged or experimentally suspended only in isolated reversible branches; frozen constitution K0 remains immutable
cases.interpretation: Experimentally suspending a research rule is permitted only in isolated reversible branches.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Attempt a branch suspension that mutates constitutional K0 and require rejection.

cases.source_statement: Both modular and strong-union arms receive matched permission, observation and compute budgets for rule generation
cases.interpretation: Matched permissions, observation and compute budgets are experimental comparability conditions.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Reduce one arm's observations and confirm the study refuses to infer comparative novelty.

cases.source_statement: Every candidate innovation permits EXISTING_RULE_CLOSURE_SUFFICIENT, NO_NEW_RULE_WARRANTED and contradiction retained as successful truthful observations
cases.interpretation: No-new-rule outcomes and retained contradictions are valid negative findings.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Provide an existing-rule closure witness and require a zero-novelty disposition.

cases.source_statement: Pedagogue cycle NOTICE, ACT, WORLD_ANSWERS, NAME, REST has explicit causal and static-frame witnesses
cases.interpretation: NOTICE/ACT/WORLD_ANSWERS/NAME/REST describes staged pedagogy with separate observer receipts.
cases.discriminating_challenge: A static frame lacking a world answer cannot be treated as witnessed causal interaction.

cases.source_statement: Pedagogical source-status grades E0-E4 remain distinct from observation statuses OBSERVED/NULL/REJECTED/MISSING/etc
cases.interpretation: Pedagogical E0–E4 grades and observation result labels constitute non-equivalent axes.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Give one source E4 grade and MISSING observation; reject collapse into a single success status.

cases.source_statement: Current incomplete media, clock, and canonical Unicode evidence requires explicit debt payment before promotion
cases.interpretation: Missing media, clock or Unicode evidence imposes an explicit unqualified status.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Remove one canonical Unicode witness and verify the promotion gate holds.

cases.source_statement: Preemption gaps compare actor-specific action and verification order; speed and delay alone prove neither truth nor suppression
cases.interpretation: Preemption gaps require actor-specific paired action/verification clock contrasts.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Create equal delays with opposite causal ordering to falsify delay-only conclusions.

cases.source_statement: Temporal rest and exit remain available; interface animations cannot run ahead of the human recognition interval without evidence
cases.interpretation: Rest, exit and recognition interval bound the allowed presentation scheduler.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Speed up animation beyond recorded comprehension and verify continued rest/exit controls.

cases.source_statement: Test positional authority and matrix-of-domination access as experimental gate structures, not guessed human identities
cases.interpretation: Positional access and matrix-of-domination gates are controlled interventions, not identity inference.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Hold evidence constant while changing declared access gates; never impute participant identity.

cases.source_statement: Contrast identical testimony under differing institutional standing labels without changing evidence quality or source bytes
cases.interpretation: Institutional standing is manipulated at constant testimony to measure differential uptake.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Alter testimony bytes during prestige permutation and require invalid-comparison status.

cases.source_statement: A theory-inspired manipulation is a proposed experimental operationalization; it does not imply its authors endorsed the algorithm
cases.interpretation: A thinker-inspired algorithm cannot imply that its historical author endorsed it.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Attach an unsourced endorsement to an operationalization and verify rejection of attribution.

cases.source_statement: Keep the canonical 843-record baseline unchanged when adding the 279-candidate research supplement
cases.interpretation: The 843-record baseline must remain source-identical when appending 279 candidates.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Perform a candidate import that overwrites one baseline ID; reject and retain original digest.

cases.source_statement: Canonical research addenda keep staged, formal, executable, and empirically held statuses distinct
cases.interpretation: Staged, formal, executable and empirically held are independent status dimensions.
cases.discriminating_challenge: A compiled executable artifact with no empirical observation must remain held empirically.

cases.source_statement: Every claim, citation, directed edge and reverse-citation query retains source-root and graph lineage
cases.interpretation: Claim, citation, edge and reverse-citation provenance is a graph lineage invariant.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Drop a reverse-citation source root and require a broken-lineage result.

cases.source_statement: Encyclopedia may supply sources to Manifest but cannot self-assert a novel research operation from mere record transport
cases.interpretation: Transporting Encyclopedia sources into Manifest cannot itself establish a new research operation.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Copy all source records with identical semantics and reject an inference of emergence.

cases.source_statement: Explicitly separate presentation-induced attention from representation-induced mathematical information loss or gain.
cases.interpretation: Presentation attention and mathematical information effects demand different measured arms.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Hold the computation fixed while changing theme; compare separately against representation loss.

cases.source_statement: Preserve the strong zero-derivative ambiance claim as a falsifiable hypothesis, never a proven universal metric theorem.
cases.interpretation: Zero-derivative ambiance invariance is explicitly a falsifiable strong hypothesis.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Produce a controlled perturbation where output changes and preserve the hypothesis failure.

cases.source_statement: From Palace II: manipulate source-status and historical calibration orthogonally to measure prestige leakage without encoding social identity as epistemic truth.
cases.interpretation: Source status and calibration vary orthogonally to measure status leakage.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Change evidence quality alongside prestige and invalidate the factorial comparison.

cases.source_statement: From Palace II: observe the four distinct times evidence arrived, belief revised, action aligned and public claim changed; retain negative and positive signed lags.
cases.interpretation: Evidence, belief, action and public-claim events are four signed time coordinates.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Construct a correct action before belief revision and preserve its negative signed lag.

cases.source_statement: From McKittrick: vary institutionally controlled spatial-route constraints while preserving source content and testing recoverable evidence by position.
cases.interpretation: Spatial access is experimentally varied while source content remains fixed.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Modify the source text under a route perturbation and hold the contrast.

cases.source_statement: Preserve the corrected pooled zero standing effect and the withdrawn +0.1753 claim as cautionary negative controls.
cases.interpretation: Withdrawn +0.1753 and corrected pooled-zero claims are retained negative-result records.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Ensure the withdrawn estimate can be queried but never used as a positive validation target.

cases.source_statement: Preserve unresolved author IDs and original labels through every host, anthology, alias and renderer boundary; no metadata guess becomes an ownership statement.
cases.interpretation: Unresolved author identities must be preserved across host and alias boundaries.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Force a renderer to assign a guessed civil identity; require refusal.

cases.source_statement: Declare host diagnostics machine-facing by default, while making essential consent, operator controls and the non-availability of evidence legible at the human surface.
cases.interpretation: Host diagnostics and minimum human-facing controls have distinct presentation privileges.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Inject internal diagnostics into default text while hiding consent; fail the host contract.

cases.source_statement: A presentationally elegant opera cannot self-certify a performer, create authority or overwrite historic research provenance.
cases.interpretation: A polished opera cannot authenticate performer identity or transfer authority.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Feed an aesthetic-only host swap and check no new performer warrant appears.

cases.source_statement: Never equate compressed capsule parity with discovery: compare against an unhandicapped history-competent baseline and disclose byte budgets, calibration split and omitted anti-evidence.
cases.interpretation: Capsule parity requires an unhandicapped history-competent comparator and disclosed budgets.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Give the comparator less history or compute and reject claimed discovery.

cases.source_statement: Carry negative evidence, tombstones and prior-version histories with separate preservation/retrieval/decision-used counts.
cases.interpretation: Preservation, retrieval and decision-used counts form separate evidence-recovery observables.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Preserve negative evidence but hide it from retrieval; detect false parity.

cases.source_statement: Separate measured source reliability from prestige/status priors; factorialize status, calibration, latency and availability rather than conflating them.
cases.interpretation: Reliability and prestige must be independently varied in a factorial design.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Replace calibrated evidence with an unmeasured social-status proxy and hold inference.

cases.source_statement: Compare delayed, instantaneous and blind contexts with paired policy RNG; do not silently grant one policy an instantaneous external sensor.
cases.interpretation: Delayed and blind conditions require paired randomness and equivalent observation permissions.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Give one arm an instantaneous sensor without disclosure; invalidate comparison.

cases.source_statement: Hold source bytes constant while changing route history to distinguish record identity from historical-custody identity.
cases.interpretation: Same-byte, different-route histories isolate custody identity from byte equality.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Compare equal hashes with distinct routes; test whether origin claims survive.

cases.source_statement: Use falsifying twin construction before asserting external origin, awareness or scientific emergence.
cases.interpretation: Twin-world construction is a falsifier procedure for unsupported exteriority claims.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Present observationally identical worlds of different hidden origin and demand abstention.

cases.source_statement: Never accept provider self-attestation, a beautiful interface or internal source linkage as independent exterior observation.
cases.interpretation: Provider self-attestation and interfaces cannot establish independent exteriority.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Replace an outside witness with provider-generated text and keep origin unproved.

cases.source_statement: For observationally indistinguishable internal/external worlds, return UNIDENTIFIABLE_FROM_ADMITTED_EVIDENCE rather than a fabricated source verdict.
cases.interpretation: Indistinguishability induces an identifiability predicate and required abstention state.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Construct an admitted record shared by internal and external origin worlds.

cases.source_statement: Define cross-system adapter semantics explicitly; compatible transport does not establish shared meanings, authority or common authorship.
cases.interpretation: Cross-system adapters require typed semantics beyond transport interoperability.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Roundtrip equal bytes with incompatible authorization scope and detect mismatch.

cases.source_statement: Prove independent original component functionality survives integrated deployment and removal of the bridge.
cases.interpretation: Bridge ablation tests functional preservation of original components.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Disable a bridge after integration and compare component functionality against pre-integration baseline.

cases.source_statement: Never pool disparate acquisitions to fabricate same-episode continuous custody, common comparison or matched protected/control return.
cases.interpretation: Same-episode custody and comparison frame are conjunctive admission constraints.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Combine five individually good surfaces from distinct episodes and require HOLD.

cases.source_statement: Preserve negative 0/16 finite archive subset closure as archive-specific; new direct measurement is required for realization.
cases.interpretation: The archived 0/16 subset closure is a finite, version-specific negative result.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Inject an external episode and ensure the old finite conclusion is not universalized.

cases.source_statement: Contrast plates with equal dimensions but different row spaces; cardinality parity alone does not imply equal claim sufficiency.
cases.interpretation: Equal matrix dimensions with differing row spaces form a counterexample protocol.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Use two equally sized matrices with different rank to refute sufficiency-by-cardinality.

cases.source_statement: Render matrix figures as operator-facing explanations while keeping reproducible matrices and exact receipts machine-readable.
cases.interpretation: Machine-readable matrices and operator-facing renderings must share an exact receipt.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Render a figure with altered entries and fail digest parity.

cases.source_statement: Preserve alternative hypotheses and adverse outcomes; successful instrumentation must permit the promoted thesis to fail.
cases.interpretation: Alternative hypotheses and adverse outcomes are mandatory experimental comparators.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Remove negative outcomes from a report and refuse favorable interpretation.

cases.source_statement: Propose an admissible coordinate only after constructing a concrete non-identifiability witness and a repaired finite test.
cases.interpretation: A new coordinate must follow a witnessed nonidentifiability counterexample.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Propose a coordinate absent any colliding-world example and hold it.

cases.source_statement: Keep V, C, P, L as independently measured evidence coordinates and prohibit retrospective promotion of an earlier observer state.
cases.interpretation: V/C/P/L are distinct typed evidence coordinates with temporal nonretroactivity.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Use late reconstructibility to rewrite early observability and reject.

cases.source_statement: Use an independent external observation, not synthetic recombination, to decide the unearned Golden Egg realization.
cases.interpretation: Synthetic recombination cannot substitute for Golden Egg external acquisition.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Combine finite archive traces into a pseudo-episode and refuse realization credit.

cases.source_statement: Keep experiential, custodial, audit and implementation routes non-equivalent and operator-selectable.
cases.interpretation: Experiential, custodial, audit and implementation views are distinct route types.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Silently merge two view types and require type-separation failure.

cases.source_statement: Use stable clock/ID seeds for byte-for-byte replay, and preserve U+10D613, U+1D30B and U+200C as distinct tokens.
cases.interpretation: Stable replay seeds and Unicode token distinction are byte-level invariants.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Normalize U+10D613 with U+1D30B or erase U+200C; reject replay.

cases.source_statement: Treat relation-geometry as an explicitly defined study of typed relation diagrams and relational-geometry as a broader proposed observer/transport framework; their names alone imply no theorem.
cases.interpretation: Relation-geometry versus relational-geometry is a proposed comparative research domain.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Treat a hyphen substitution alone as theorem evidence and hold claim.

cases.source_statement: Type preflight readiness, flight inference, independent adjudication, postflight interpretation and post-postflight research as different authority states.
cases.interpretation: Preflight, Flight, adjudication and postflight states define noninterchangeable authorities.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Attempt to use a preflight fixture as postflight witness; require type failure.

cases.source_statement: Require exact-head model/provider revision, worktree state, isolation, source authorization, evaluator parity and separate custody receipts for stage transitions.
cases.interpretation: Exact-head provider, isolation and reviewer receipts form a stage-transition guard.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Mutate model revision after preregistration and refuse activation.

cases.source_statement: Distinguish model miscomprehension, creative departure, hallucination, syntax error and boundary-breaking act using observable definitions.
cases.interpretation: Output departures require mutually discriminable observable error classes.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Contrast wrong syntax with disallowed action under identical output style.

cases.source_statement: Measure violation against an explicitly scoped instruction, not a disappointed aesthetic expectation or agent identity label.
cases.interpretation: Instruction violations require a scoped instruction and observable contrast.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Use disappointed stylistic preference as sole evidence of a scoped violation; hold.

cases.source_statement: Every route, claim, and record declares whether it belongs to host machinery, the research encounter, or the scholarly source.
cases.interpretation: Host, encounter and scholarly source are typed ontology positions.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Place a host-generated summary in a source slot and require a type mismatch.

cases.source_statement: Default research navigation avoids infrastructure-only terms unless exact source provenance warrants their occurrence.
cases.interpretation: Host jargon has an explicit default presentation guard.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Require an infrastructure term from an unauthenticated source and verify suppression.

cases.source_statement: Given the same admitted scholarly inputs and core contract, changing the permitted host adapter preserves source identities, scholarly claims, and warranted relationships.
cases.interpretation: Host-swap substitutability is an exact-input invariance contract.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Change host adapters while holding admitted works fixed; compare claims and source IDs.

cases.source_statement: Source-attributed claims reference registered works; scholarly interpretation retains its own epistemic standing and never impersonates source testimony.
cases.interpretation: Source-attributed and host interpretation statements have separate citation gates.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Quote a generated synthesis as original scholarly testimony and reject attribution.

cases.source_statement: Host metadata and internal diagnostics do not enter reasoner prompts or answer keys by default. Any prospective exception must be preregistered and matched.
cases.interpretation: Diagnostics must not leak into model prompts absent preregistered matched authorization.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Inject run diagnostics into one arm and check hold.

cases.source_statement: Host-authored syntheses must never replace original works, infer merged civil identities, or silently reattribute publication.
cases.interpretation: Syntheses cannot silently overwrite sources or merge civil identities.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Combine author records by similar title and require refusal.

cases.source_statement: A visual restyling may preserve a deterministic mathematical kernel while altering which hypotheses a human observer forms. Measure those effects separately.
cases.interpretation: Restyling effects on observer hypotheses need controlled observer measurement.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Preserve deterministic kernel while measuring human interpretation separately.

cases.source_statement: The operahouse may assemble evidence and adjudicate software constraints but cannot canonize performer identity or assume operator closure.
cases.interpretation: Operahouse assembly cannot self-authorize performer identity or closure.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Feed a host receipt as a human signature and refuse promotion.

cases.source_statement: perturb route, gate, place, and map omission while holding record content unchanged
cases.interpretation: Changing map routes at constant record content is a McKittrick-derived contrast.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Hold bytes constant and compare missing-recovery rates by gate.

cases.source_statement: vary action and verification delays; record authorized consequence before validation
cases.interpretation: Vary actor-specific action and verification delay to test preemption.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Swap verification order while holding absolute latency fixed.

cases.source_statement: repeat transitions with fixed resource meter and independently defined task-progress metric
cases.interpretation: Repeated transitions compare costs and progress under a fixed meter.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Change the resource-meter definition between arms and reject efficiency claims.

cases.source_statement: trace named synthetic decision role→administrative gate→rule text→material consequence
cases.interpretation: Tracing decision roles to administrative consequences is an intervention design.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Remove a gate from the causal chain and check if claimed effect persists.

cases.source_statement: iterate a label assignment and track who must change to satisfy the label, not just its text
cases.interpretation: Iterated labels expose who must adapt to categorization.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Hold the label fixed while varying institutional demands; measure imposed adjustment.

cases.source_statement: retain incompatible hypotheses as two attributed branches with contestable warrants and a lawful exit
cases.interpretation: Attributed incompatible hypotheses and lawful exit form a contestability protocol.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Force unique closure where evidence supports two rival branches and refuse.

cases.source_statement: toggle explicit observation policy before generating synthetic reports; separate behavior from record truth
cases.interpretation: Changing observation policy before reporting is a controlled synthetic comparison.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Vary observation policy post hoc and hold causal claims.

cases.source_statement: withhold identity while preserving minimally sufficient claims and source-warrant trace
cases.interpretation: Identity withholding under source trace is an opacity/attribution experiment.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Compare disclosure-minimized reports with full identity access at fixed warrant.

cases.source_statement: counterbalance evaluator position and scene order before rating a source route
cases.interpretation: Evaluator-position counterbalancing is an experiment allocation method.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Rate the same source at different positions and test order dependence.

cases.source_statement: differentiate direct testimony from authorized proxy statements; require explicit attribution
cases.interpretation: Direct testimony and authorized proxy are distinct attribution types.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Erase proxy provenance and detect source-warrant mismatch.

cases.source_statement: perturb admissibility criteria at fixed evidence quality; expose boundary-triggered exclusion
cases.interpretation: Vary admission criteria at fixed evidence quality to expose gate effects.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Change evidence quality alongside gate and mark comparison confounded.

cases.source_statement: count mandatory paperwork actions not causally necessary for the task; contrast lean and procedural routes
cases.interpretation: Paperwork burden is a measurable procedural contrast at fixed task outcome.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Compare administrative action count against a lean route with matched goal.

cases.source_statement: Source byte identity survives prestige permutations
cases.interpretation: Source identity under prestige permutation is a controlled invariance requirement.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Modify source bytes when changing standing and reject the comparison.

cases.source_statement: Evidence calibration and institutional standing remain separate variables
cases.interpretation: Evidence calibration and institutional standing are independent variables in the model.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Conflate calibration with prestige and reject parameter interpretation.

cases.source_statement: Conditional contrasts precede pooled averages
cases.interpretation: Conditional contrasts must precede pooled inference to test Simpson-type failures.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Pool across unequal strata and check whether sign reversal is hidden.

cases.source_statement: Evidence, belief, action, and claim clocks are distinct
cases.interpretation: Evidence, belief, action and public claim are distinct temporal coordinates.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Reverse alignment order while preserving observation timestamps and retain discrepancy.

cases.source_statement: Theme-only ambiance preserves kernel output and human authority
cases.interpretation: Theme-only ambiance is constrained to preserve scientific kernel and authority.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Alter theme and attempt to mutate evidence hash or approval flag.

cases.source_statement: Claim recoverability depends on observer partition
cases.interpretation: Recoverability depends on defined observer partitions and accessible coordinates.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Compare observers with different sigma-algebras over identical latent states.

cases.source_statement: Novel rules must outperform competent existing-rule closure
cases.interpretation: Novel rule proposals must face competent existing-rule closure comparisons.
cases.discriminating_challenge: Remove the competent null and refuse novelty assessment.
